# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is described as a remarkably attractive and charming young woman with an asymmetrical mouth, tiny white teeth, and brown tones in her features. After having children, she notes that she has grown dreadfully skinny and less pleasant-looking than before.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Lighthearted, affectionate, and famously indecisive, Cressy often appears silly on the surface but possesses a faithful and loving nature. She admits to struggling with personal decisions and worrying about disagreeable topics or illness. Beneath her airy exterior, she is loyal to her friends, free from snobbery, and capable of working hard and standing firm when it matters.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), [v3 c24 P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)_

- Mathematics  <sub>[v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- Social charm and popularity  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>

## History

Cressida first met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis in a Wexcombe cemetery, quickly introducing herself by her nickname Cressy and taking an instant liking to them. Her social prominence, charm, and beauty helped introduce Nell and Honora to many college circles during their time at Wexcombe. Throughout her freshman year, she struggled to choose between her suitors Hector and Orlando, while also sharing housing with Nell, Honora, Mabel, and Aunt Euphemia at Tabby's Place. During her final year at college, she fell in love with a minister named Ezra Hale, persevered against her mother's initial disapproval, and married him the week following their college completion. The couple settled on Tanner Street in the Patterson slums, where she later gave birth to children. Prior to Nell's wedding to Hugh Carrow, Cressy sent Hugh a letter clarifying that Nell and Cyril Lisle were not engaged, encouraging him to pursue Nell again.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c10 P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a wealthy and prominent man from an established elite Bluenose family  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Paternal grandfather was a minister  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
- Raised in Harborough, Nova Scotia at Mount Holly  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
